title: Copilot Workspaces: Updated workspace memory
summary: Copilot in Workspaces now retains workspace memory to provide more relevant, consistent responses across sessions, improving productivity. Public Preview began November 2026; General Availability starts December 2026. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed of the update. No compliance issues identified.
body:
[What and Why:]

Copilot in Workspaces now retains useful workspace context to provide more relevant, consistent responses across sessions.

Saved workspace memory can include evolving work context inside the workspace, recurring instructions, and working preferences to reduce repeated setup.

[Rollout Schedule:]

Public Preview (Worldwide): began in November 2026.

General Availability (Worldwide): expected to begin in December 2026 and continue through early 2027.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Users with eligible Copilot licensing will see improved continuity in Copilot responses within Workspaces due to retained workspace memory.

This can improve productivity and consistency for recurring workspace tasks.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

No admin action is required. We recommend informing users of updated memory behavior in Workspaces.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
